Convert between binary, decimal and hexadecimal in unsigned, sign-magnitude, ones' complement and two's complement, and see the range for a chosen width. Draft: it changes until Blake approves it.

```{=html}
<div id="number-systems"></div>
<noscript><p>The number systems converter needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./src/app.js";
  window.numberSystems = mount(document.getElementById("number-systems"));
</script>
```
